summary: Paso De Los Libres Airport serves the border city of Paso de los Libres in Corrientes Province, northeastern Argentina, situated near the Uruguay River across from Brazil. The airport primarily supports regional connectivity for this important international border crossing point, handling domestic flights and general aviation traffic. Its location makes it a gateway for travelers moving between Argentina and southern Brazil.
faqs:
Q: Where is Paso De Los Libres Airport located?
A: The airport is located near the city of Paso de los Libres in Corrientes Province, Argentina, close to the border with Brazil.

Q: What type of flights does the airport handle?
A: As a medium-sized airport, it primarily serves domestic regional flights and general aviation operations.

Q: Is the airport near any major tourist destinations?
A: It is near the Uruguay River and serves as an access point for the Mesopotamia region of Argentina, including the Iberá Wetlands nearby.

Q: What is the nearest international crossing?
A: The city itself features a major international bridge connecting Argentina with the Brazilian city of Quaraí.
transport_tips: The airport is located a short drive from downtown Paso de los Libres, typically reachable by taxi or private vehicle within minutes. Public transportation options are limited, so arranging ground transport in advance is advisable. Rental cars are generally not available on-site, so booking through hotels or local agencies is recommended.
local_tip: If traveling between Argentina and Brazil, note that Paso de los Libres and the neighboring Brazilian city of Quaraí operate on different time zones and currencies, so plan your bridge crossing and document checks accordingly.
